description: SR-138 exception list (E03-T02): packages genuinely needing a postinstall/preinstall/install lifecycle script under the repo's global `ignore-scripts=true` (.npmrc). Reviewed by the Security engineer per this ticket's Definition of Done. Each entry documents why the script is safe (no network fetch beyond the package's own known, pinned binary download; no arbitrary code execution).

packages.name: electron
packages.reason: Downloads the pinned Electron binary for the desktop shell (apps/desktop, E02-T04). Fetches only from Electron's own release CDN, pinned by the exact version in pnpm-lock.yaml.

packages.name: esbuild
packages.reason: Downloads the pinned platform-specific esbuild binary, a transitive dev-dependency of vitest and vite and, since #3422, a direct devDependency of @candleviewer/ui (the build:tokens CSS check, exact-pinned to the version Vite resolves). Fetches only from esbuild's own release CDN, pinned by the exact version in pnpm-lock.yaml.
packages.reviewedBy: security-reviewer (E02-X01); the direct devDependency use re-reviewed under #3422
